text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum-huuum! Which one should I go 
with~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, doing some shopping? I guess the 
famous "Ticketzo Express" is off duty 
today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Maruzen-san! Actually— I don't have 
any packages today, so I thought I'd 
deliver myself instead!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a choverig idea~! I'll be 
rooting for you to make a wonderful 
delivery♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look what I found!! This is perfect 
for cheering on someone who's working 
hard! Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The ribbon's color... definitely gotta be 
red! It feels so fiery!! Alright, all 
that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is for 'Ticketzo Express' 
to deliver it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's all—well, mostly... Hmmm...

Oh, there you are. Hey, tell me more about 
this 'Ticketzo Express'—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I came to hear what you had to say, but 
you're looking rather down. Did some 
trouble come up?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah―― No, no! I'm just going to deliver my 
stuff right now!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's just... somehow, um... I feel like 
it's still not enough, or something—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just like everyone else, I put my heart 
into picking the gift and wrapping it with 
all my might, so it should be perfect, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh... You feel like you "haven't 
conveyed your feelings fully"? I know the 
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
When giving something to someone important 
to you, it's only natural to want to put 
your whole heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how does an approach like 
this sound—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I see... Air Groove!!!! That is the 
absolute best!!!

One day, while buried under a mountain of 
paperwork in the trainer's office...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Knock knock knock! Trainer, are you in 
there?!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Safe and reliable 'Ticketzo Express' at 
your service! I've got a package delivery! 
The sender is—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's me! Winning Ticket! ...Ehehe! Open it 
up!

Untying the ribbon and carefully unfolding 
the wrapping paper— inside was the latest 
stretching equipment!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"See, this strengthens your core and 
increases your flexibility! I wanted to 
help you build a body that doesn't get 
tired easily, Trainer!"
choice_data_list:
Huh, amazing! I'll be sure to treasure and 
take good care of it!

Huh, amazing! I'll be sure to treasure and 
take good care of it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And you know what, you know what?! That's 
not all! Actually...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... I feel kind of restless...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: ......A-Actually, you see... Uhm...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: —Here, this is for you!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Listen! Air Groove actually gave me some 
advice!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I thought... giving a bouquet along with 
the gift would be a good way to convey my 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"It's not just... the gratitude I always 
try to convey to you...!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The precious, special feelings hidden 
deep, deep within my heart that I haven't 
been able to tell you yet—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because I want you to receive every single 
bit of my feelings—all of theeeem!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: How is it...!? Do you... like it...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: T-Thank goodneeeeeeessss!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Phewwwww... It's so ticklish. For some 
reason, my heart was pounding like 
crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I've never really given someone flowers 
like this before, ehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, it's so great! Together with 
the flowers... *poof!* My feelings of love 
will burst into full bloom!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: J-Just kidding! Oww... It's so itchy...
choice_data_list:
I'm so happy!! Let's put it on display 
right away!

text_block_list.text:
As I was putting the bouquet from Winning 
Ticket into a vase—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that red rose was the first one I 
picked!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The florist told me that its flower 
language means "passion"!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"You're always looking out for me, 
scolding me and praising me, so I thought 
it was perfect for you, Trainer!!"

Receiving a heartfelt bouquet and gift 
from Winning Ticket made it an 
unforgettable day.

As I was putting the bouquet from Winning 
Ticket into a vase—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that pink tulip, you know, it was the 
first one I picked!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The florist told me that its flower 
language means "devoted love"!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was perfect for a Trainer who 
thinks so deeply and seriously about my 
races and about me!!

Receiving a heartfelt bouquet and gift 
from Winning Ticket made it an 
unforgettable day.

As I was putting the bouquet from Winning 
Ticket into a vase—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that white rose, you know, it was the 
first one I picked!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The florist told me that its flower 
language means "deep respect"!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, you study races and training so 
much, and you're always teaching me allll 
kinds of things, right?"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So I thought it was a perfect match for 
how I feel about you, Trainer!

Receiving a heartfelt bouquet and gift 
from Winning Ticket made it an 
unforgettable day.
